workflow.title: Secure API Endpoint Implementation Workflow
workflow.step: Define Zod request and response schemas with strict() mode to prevent Mass Assignment (BE-VAL-001, BE-VAL-002).
Register HTTP route with method and plural resource naming, attach Zod validation middleware and Auth guard (BE-API-001, SEC-AUTH-001).
Implement business logic with Anti-BOLA tenancy filters and transaction isolation for mutations (BE-DB-001, BE-DB-002).
Wrap successful data in standard envelope { success: true, data, error: null, meta } (BE-API-002).
Write integration tests against real PostgreSQL test instance with transaction rollback (TEST-INT-001).
